correctness.rationale: The ordinary independence complex has exactly 12 vertices, 36 independent edges and 20 independent triangles, with no independent set of cardinality four. Its 30 triangle-core edges each have two triangle cofaces; five-cycle links and chi=12-30+20=2 make the connected core a triangulated S^2. Six additional distance-three antipodal edges attach as 1-cells, hence Ind(I) is homotopy equivalent to S^2 wedge six circles, H1=Z^6, H2=Z. The relative homology exact sequence identifies integral H1 with the oriented six-edge signed permutation lattice. Rotational traces (6,-2,0,1) agree with the two conjugate three-dimensional A5 characters; central antipodal inversion acts -1 in H1 and H2. Antipode acts freely on the sphere, quotient RP2, and six reversed extra edges yield contractible pendant quotient intervals. Independent graph construction counted (12,36,20,0) faces and all 30 twice-incident core edges. Read exact finite 120-automorphism source including Lefschetz consistency, not merely an OK log; the equivariant wedge splitting is not asserted.
